## Linked Issue

Tracking [#2244](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2244) carries no implementation. All remain OPEN/WIP.

## Scope Summary

Wire actual original preparation to one canonical global execution. prepareCanonicalAtomicCiGroup consumes frontend fragment admission and public-runtime preparePublicRuntimeAttemptContexts, and installs original coverage request/material checks through the original requiredInputAdmission seam. executeCanonicalAtomicCiGroup dispatches fully consumed frontend/coverage graphs exactly once through executeCompiledAtomicProducerDag. Complete selection and one canonical CI runner group are required. Original capacity/commands/retry/finalizers/errors/full vectors are preserved; held input refusal allocates zero attempts and independent siblings continue.

Backend/static prepare-only ports are absent in their original wrappers. Public preparation is used, while original runtime admission and missing pre-notification-stream reset assertion/postflight remain pending. Whole-graph input is always owner-supplied; this source does not construct a production matrix/catalogue/workflow or qualify runtime/native/release evidence. Existing bounded navigation/scanner material still lacks canonical authenticated publication/transitive launch and gate registration.

Exact source-only original capabilities:5c1b8cd7a9dd4e3902d38f1ce451b4c8998f907f publication error preservation,39466f9a3a4714b5b58cd4c75a8baa69588e9c9e required input admission, and d033e0296ac021bd9766f738b03dabb293bc0b90 coverage bridges. Original source/control blobs are unchanged. Their ancestor authority fixture/metadata is not consumed. Original e6a42d63861278c630c31dc025787ad452d42ce2 fixture/metadata is separately consumed by normal merge after exact1236 target/closure source byte compatibility; new executor is outside that closure and gains no qualification.

Candidate1acceddc60857a5222d93469953da3deaf65a34c, isolated codex/atomic-failure-global-invocation. Existing draft PR3970 stays frozen at395703a20dc438cf5fc74a71287536e1fa7d16c1. New draft creation is centrally queued, not performed. Full diff against fetched aaba7b8c84ecfb336c71443e30d9fd82d21fb16d is120 files:12 exclusive atomic-failure files and108 exact original-owner files. This owned source increment changes only five private files: ci-projection.mjs, existing CI control/support fixture, README and naming manifest. No independent scheduler/discovery/matrix/registry/history/authority writer changes.
